title: Maxwell_vs_Newton: A Unified k-Space Operator Framework for Stylus and Optical Profilometry
description: Simulation pipeline, verification suite and generated outputs for comparing stylus profilometry and optical interferometry through instrument transfer functions, spectral information loss, anisotropy, equivalence regimes and information-theoretic diagnostics. Companion to the manuscript 'Optical Profilometry Versus the Stylus: A Spectral Theory for Closing the Accuracy Gap'.
